summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Pothole Detector application with backend API, frontend UI, and batch evaluator. All core functionality working correctly with Gemini 2.0 Flash integration.
passed_tests: Backend /api/detect endpoint accepts JPEG and PNG images
Backend validates image types and rejects invalid files
Backend returns proper JSON schema with all required fields
Frontend page loads with proper title and layout
Frontend drag-drop zone functional with visual feedback
Frontend responsive design works across viewports
Batch evaluator script processes multiple images successfully
API response times reasonable (1-1.4 seconds average)
Error handling working for invalid inputs
